plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an engineer from NASA Eagle Works, a small lab at the US space agency that looked at far-out ideas for moving through space. Michels says the engineer claims to have produced 1.5 kilovolts and powered a little microchip using the Casimir effect, a tiny force that appears between objects held very close together in empty space. If true, it would mean energy can be drawn from empty space itself.
